blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas bowed out of medal contention in women’s 5-on-5 basketball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games after being eliminated by Chinese Taipei, 83-71, in Thursday’s quarterfinals. Despite a stirring performance from Afril Bernardino, Gilas couldn’t overhaul a double-digit deficit as its bid for a first-ever semifinal appearance in the Asian Games vanished into thin air at Aichi International Arena. Chinese Taipei barged its way into the semifinals after taking full control of the contest despite a slow start that allowed Gilas to hold a 9-2 lead. Bernardino scored […]...
